facts.text: I am thinking of trying out a new recipe for rustic Italian bread this weekend.

I used the convection setting on my oven to bake a batch of cookies last Thursday.
The cookies I baked with convection turned out perfectly crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside.
I am thinking of trying a slower rise for the rustic Italian bread recipe.

My last attempt making bread with sourdough starter did not turn out so well.
I tried a new bread recipe using sourdough starter on Tuesday.
In that Tuesday attempt, the dough did not rise as much as I expected.
In that Tuesday attempt, the bread came out dense and heavy.
I think I need to work on my sourdough starter's health and maybe adjust the recipe.
I am willing to give it another try for the Italian bread recipe.
